pp2.1:1.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo kālena kālaṃ samayena samayaṃ aṭṭha vimokkhe kāyena phusitvā viharati paññāya c' assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhīṇā honti:
pp2.1:2.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo na h' eva kho kālena kālaṃ samayena samayaṃ aṭṭha vimokkhe kāyena phusitvā viharati paññāya c' assa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti:
pp2.1:2.4: Sabbe pi ariyapuggalā ariye vimokkhe asamayavimuttā. 3.
pp2.1:3.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo lābhī hoti rūpasahagatānaṃ vā arūpasahagatānaṃ vā samāpattīnaṃ,
pp2.1:3.3: so ca kho na nikāma-lābhī hoti na akicchalābhī na akasira-lābhī
pp2.1:3.4: na yatthicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ yāvaticchakaṃ samāpajjati pi vuṭṭhāti pi;
pp2.1:3.5: ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ vijjati yaṃ tassa puggalassa pamādam āgamma tā samāpattiyo kuppeyyuṃ:
pp2.1:4.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo lābhī hoti rūpasahagatānaṃ vā arūpasahagatānaṃ vā samāpattīnaṃ,
pp2.1:4.3: so ca kho nikāma-lābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
pp2.1:4.4: yatthicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ yāvaticchakaṃ samāpajjati pi vuṭṭhāti pi;
pp2.1:4.5: aṭṭhānaṃ etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ tassa puggalassa pamādam āgamma tā samāpattiyo kuppeyyuṃ:
pp2.1:4.7: Sabbe pi ariyapuggalā ariye vimokkhe akuppadhammā. 5.
pp2.1:5.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo lābhī hoti rūpasahagatānaṃ vā arūpasahagatānaṃ vā samāpattīnaṃ,
pp2.1:5.3: so ca kho na nikāmalābhī hoti na akicchalābhī na akasiralābhī
pp2.1:5.4: na yatthicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ yāvaticchakaṃ samāpajjati pi vuṭṭhāti pi;
pp2.1:5.5: ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ vijjati yaṃ so puggalo pamādaṃ āgamma tāhi samāpattīhi parihāreyya:
pp2.1:6.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo lābhī hoti rūpasahagatānaṃ vā arūpasahagatānaṃ vā samāpattīnaṃ,
pp2.1:6.3: so ca kho nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
pp2.1:6.4: yatthicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ yāvaticchakaṃ samāpajjati pi vuṭṭhāti pi;
pp2.1:6.5: aṭṭhānaṃ etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ so puggalo pamādaṃ āgamma tāhi samāpattīhi parihāreyya:
pp2.1:6.7: Sabbe pi ariyapuggalā ariye vimokkhe aparihānadhammā. 7.
pp2.1:7.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo lābhī hoti rūpasahagatānaṃ vā arūpasahagatānaṃ vā samāpattīnaṃ,
pp2.1:7.3: so ca kho na nikāmalābhī hoti na akicchalābhī na akasiralābhī
pp2.1:7.4: na yatthicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ yāvaticchakaṃ samāpajjati pi vuṭṭhāti pi;
pp2.1:7.5: sace anusañceteti na parihāyati tāhi samāpattīhi,
pp2.1:7.6: sace na anusañceteti parihāyati tāhi samāpattīhi:
pp2.1:8.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo lābhī hoti rūpasahagatānaṃ vā arūpasahagatānaṃ vā samāpattīnaṃ,
pp2.1:8.3: so ca kho na nikāmalābhī hoti na akicchalābhī na akasiralābhī
pp2.1:8.4: na yatthicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ yāvaticchakaṃ samāpajjati pi vuṭṭhāti pi;
pp2.1:8.5: sace anurakkhati na parihāyati tāhi samāpattīhi,
pp2.1:8.6: sace na anurakkhati parihāyati tāhi samāpattīhi:
pp2.1:9.3: na ca tesaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya paṭipanno:
pp2.1:10.2: Yesaṃ dhammānaṃ samanantarā ariyadhammassa avakkanti hoti tehi dhammehi samannāgato puggalo
pp2.1:11.2: Satta sekhā bhayūparatā ye ca puthujjanā sīlavanto:
pp2.1:12.2: Ye te puggalā kammāvaraṇena samannāgatā, kilesāvaraṇena samannāgatā, vipākāvaraṇena samannāgatā, assaddhā, acchandikā, duppaññā, jaḷā, abhabbā niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ:
pp2.1:13.2: Ye te puggalā na kammāvaraṇena samannāgatā, na kilesāvaraṇena samannāgatā, na vikāpāvaraṇena samannāgatā, saddhā, chandikā, paññavanto, bhabbā niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ:
pp2.1:14.2: Pañca puggalā ānantarikā, ye ca micchādiṭṭhikā niyatā: aṭṭha ca ariyapuggalā niyatā:
pp2.1:15.2: Cattāro magga-samaṅgino puggalā paṭipannakā: cattāro phala-samaṅgino puggalā phale ṭhitā. 19.
pp2.1:16.2: Yassa puggalassa apubbaṃ acarimaṃ āsavapariyādānañ ca hoti jīvitapariyādānañ ca:
pp2.1:17.2: Ayañ ca puggalo sotāpatti-phala-sacchikiriyāya paṭipanno assa kappassa ca uḍḍayhana-velā assa n' eva tāva kappo uḍḍayheyya yāvāyaṃ puggalo na sotāpattiphalaṃ sacchikaroti:
pp2.1:19.2: Cattāro maggasamaṅgino tayo phalasamaṅgino puggalā sekkhā;
pp2.1:19.4: avasesā puggalā n' eva sekkhā nāsekkhā 26.
pp2.1:22.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati
pp2.1:22.3: tattha ca sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇāti phalesu ca vasībhāvaṃ:
pp2.1:23.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati
pp2.1:23.3: na ca tattha sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇāti na ca phalesu vasībhāvaṃ:
pp2.1:24.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo aṭṭha vimokkhe kāyena phusitvā viharati
pp2.1:24.3: paññāya c' assa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti:
pp2.1:25.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo na h' eva kho aṭṭha vimokkhe kāyena phusitvā viharati
pp2.1:25.3: paññāya c' assa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti:
pp2.1:26.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo aṭṭha vimokkhe kāyena phusitvā viharati
pp2.1:26.3: paññāya c' assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhīṇā honti:
pp2.1:27.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti; ayaṃ dukkha-samudayo ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti; ayaṃ dukkha-nirodho ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti; ayaṃ dukkha-nirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
pp2.1:27.3: Tathāgatappaveditā c' assa dhammā paññāya vodiṭṭhā honti vocaritā,
pp2.1:27.4: paññāya c' assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhiṇā honti:
pp2.1:28.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti; ayaṃ dukkha-samudayo ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti; ayaṃ dukkha-nirodho ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti; ayaṃ dukkha-nirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
pp2.1:28.3: Tathāgatappaveditā c' assa dhammā paññāya vo diṭṭhā honti vo caritā,
pp2.1:28.4: paññāya c' assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhīṇā honti, no ca kho yathā diṭṭhippattassa:
pp2.1:29.2: Yassa puggalassa sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa paññindriyaṃ adhimattaṃ hoti paññā-vāhiṃ paññā-pubbaṅgamaṃ ariyamaggaṃ bhāveti:
pp2.1:29.4: sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo dhammānusārī, phale ṭhito diṭṭhippallo. 36.
pp2.1:30.2: Yassa puggalassa sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa saddhindriyaṃ adhimattaṃ hoti, saddhā-vāhiṃ saddhāpubbaṅgamaṃ ariyamaggaṃ bhāveti:
pp2.1:30.4: sotāphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo saddhānusārī, phale ṭhito saddhāvimutto. 37.
pp2.1:31.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā paṭipanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano:
pp2.1:31.3: so sattakkhattuṃ deve ca mānusse ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhass' antaṃ karoti:
pp2.1:32.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo tiṇṇaṃ saññojānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano:
pp2.1:32.3: so dve vā tīṇi vā kulāni sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhass' antaṃ karoti:
pp2.1:33.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano:
pp2.1:33.3: so etaṃ yeva mānussakaṃ bhavaṃ nibbattetvā dukkhass' antaṃ karoti:
pp2.1:34.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāga-dosa-mohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti, sakid eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhass' antaṃ karoti:
pp2.1:35.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti, tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā:
pp2.1:36.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti, tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā:
pp2.1:36.3: so upapannaṃ vā samanantarā apattaṃ vā vemajjhaṃ āyupamāṇaṃ ariyamaggaṃ sañjaneti upariṭṭhimānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya:
pp2.1:37.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti, tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā:
pp2.1:37.3: so atikkamitvā vemajjhaṃ āyupamāṇaṃ upahacca vā kālakiriyaṃ ariyamaggaṃ sañjaneti upariṭṭhimānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya:
pp2.1:38.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā:
pp2.1:38.3: so asaṅkhāreṇa ariyamaggaṃ sañjaneti upariṭṭhimānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya:
pp2.1:39.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā:
pp2.1:39.3: so sasaṅkhāreṇa ariyamaggaṃ sañjaneti upariṭṭhimānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya:
pp2.1:40.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā:
pp2.1:40.3: so avihā cuto atappaṃ gacchati, atappā cuto sudassaṃ gacchati, sudassā cuto sudassiṃ gacchati, sudassiyā cuto akaniṭṭhaṃ gacchati,
pp2.1:40.4: akaniṭṭhe ariyamaggaṃ sañjaneti upariṭṭhimānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya:
pp2.1:41.2: Tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpatti-phala-sacchikiriyāya paṭipanno:
pp2.1:42.1: Kāmarāgavyāpādānaṃ tanu-bhāvāya paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmi-phala-sacchikiriyāyā paṭipanno:
pp2.1:43.1: Kāmarāgavyāpādānam anavasesappahānāya paṭipanno puggalo anāgāmi-phala-sacchikiriyāya paṭipanno:
pp2.1:44.1: Rūparāga-arūparāga-māna-uddhacca-avijjāya anavasesappahānāya paṭipanno puggalo arahatta-phala-sacchikiriyāya paṭipanno:
pp2.1:44.2: yassa puggalasa rūparāgo arūparāgo māno uddhaccaṃ avijjā anavasesā pahīnā
